title: Renewal and Claims-Frequency Values, LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy
content:
Renewal values of the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy by tier: the paid-claims count at which a property becomes eligible for nonrenewal, the claims lookback window, the renewal rate cap, the inflation guard on Coverage A and the renewal offer lead time.

| | DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paid claims on the property in the lookback at which it becomes eligible for nonrenewal | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 4 |
| Claims lookback window (months) | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 |
| Renewal rate cap: largest renewal premium increase over the expiring term premium (percent) | 25 | 20 | 15 | 15 | 12 | 10 |
| Inflation guard: automatic Coverage A increase at renewal (percent) | 0 (none) | 4 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 5 |
| Renewal offer lead time: days before expiration the renewal is billed (calendar days) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 60 |

## Reading the table

- The claims lookback is 36 calendar months on every tier.
- LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic has no inflation guard; DP-2 Broad through DP-3 Special Plus use 4 percent and DP-3 Premier and DP-3 Portfolio use 5 percent.
- LandlordGuard DP-3 Portfolio is offered for renewal 60 days before expiration; every other tier 45 days before.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical expiring term premium of 2,000.00 USD increased by the LandlordGuard DP-2 Broad renewal rate cap of 20 percent gives 2,400.00 USD; on LandlordGuard DP-3 Premier the 12 percent cap gives 2,240.00 USD.
